scope: One bilingual chapter after document classification and before T5. Resolve a document's mentions, retrieve and rerank entity IDs, extract relations and a dated event. No new practice route.

sources.sections: Jurafsky & Martin, SLP ch. 21 (relations, events, time) and ch. 24 (mentions, coreference, linking)
sources.verification: Separate event, trigger, role and date; distinguish local mention clusters from external IDs; the Anna Levina document and catalog are constructed for this walkthrough.

sources.sections: Lee et al., End-to-end Neural Coreference Resolution §§2–4 and Fig. 2; Pradhan et al. §2, B³
sources.verification: Verify the sum of mention and pair scores and fixed dummy antecedent; compare cluster intersection denominators on aligned mention boundaries.

sources.sections: Wu et al., Scalable Zero-shot Entity Linking with Dense Entity Retrieval §§3–4 and Fig. 1
sources.verification: Trace independent context/description scoring, top-K, and joint reranking. The NIL option is a deployment requirement, not attributed to the figure or the closed candidate benchmark.

sources.sections: Yao et al., DocRED §3 and Fig. 1; Wadden et al., DyGIE++ §2 and Fig. 1; Chang & Manning, SUTime §2–3
sources.verification: Trace document-level evidence with local entity IDs, trigger/role labeling and time anchors. Preserve DyGIE++'s within-sentence relation output and distinguish it from its cross-sentence representations.
